r0.why: Osteichthyes name from Greek bone+fish, bony endoskeleton, contrast with cartilaginous and extinct groups, 45 orders/435 families/28,000 species in 1-3

r1.why: Ray-finned vs lobe-finned split, 436 My early Silurian fossils with intermediate tooth pattern, cartilaginous early skeletons and foregut pouches in 4-6

r2.why: Diverticula for air breathing in low-oxygen water, swim bladders for buoyancy, lungs in lobe-finned line, lungfish and skin/gut respiration in 17-19,39,40

r3.why: Fleshy fins vs fin spines, articulated fin skeletons giving tetrapod limbs, opercula drawing water so they breathe without swimming in 20,21

r4.why: No placoid scales, scales below epidermis, cosmoid/ganoid/teleost with cycloid/ctenoid, bone layers, enamel and dentin in 22-27

r5.why: Traditional class criteria, paraphyly because common ancestor has tetrapod descendants, post-2013 trees making Osteichthyes = Euteleostomi in 28,29,36

r6.why: Primitively ectothermic, independent endothermy in opah/swordfish/tuna, any heterotroph diet, hermaphrodites, usually external fertilisation in 41-45
